versions.changelog:
Initial release of AI Instagram Engagement Strategy Assistant.

- Provides tailored engagement strategies focused on content interaction, visibility, and audience relationship building.
- Generates post ideas, captions, content pillars, reels concepts, posting schedules, and hashtag strategies.
- Offers audience engagement techniques, content optimization tips, and performance review suggestions.
- Supports a wide range of users: creators, businesses, social media managers, and influencers.
- Includes resources and frameworks for planning, experimentation, and consistent growth on Instagram.
